title: Dwarf Looter
description:
Ludum Dare 54 Entry
Descend Into the Depths 
Descend into the depths as a greedy dwarf in search of loot and riches in this roguelike dungeon crawler RPG. Each passage presents new challenges as you explore procedurally generated ruins full of enemies to fight and treasures to find.Danger and Reward Await
The deeper you go, the greater the rewards, but also the greater the danger. Gather powerful weapons, bizarre hats and tasty snacks to prepare for epic battles against rats, demon lords, dragons and half a dozen goblins. Beware of the GREED curse that afflicts wealthy dwarves, making escape to the top all the more perilous the greater your booty.Master Dwarf Combat
Master deep combat mechanics combining axes, shields, legendary armor and salamis. Discover strange magical artifacts among piles of gold and gems. But know when to stop - death is permanent in the depths, so use your gold and courage wisely.Become the Richest Dwarf
Dwarf Looter blends reduced inventory management leading to highly improvised situations and choices, procedural generation, turn-based combat and a light RPG progression in a humorous fantasy world. Can you defeat the final boss and become the richest dwarf, or will you die of a mushroom overdose first?
description_short: Delve into procedural underground, wielding quirky weapons and bizarre hats. Conquer rats, goblins, and demon lords, all while amassing treasures - but your limited inventory space WILL leads to tough choices. Beware your growing greed in this humor-infused fantasy roguelike challenge!
